# DRY EYECARE

> DRY EYECARE is the dedicated dry eye practice of PRO EYECARE, led by Dr. Inna Lazar, OD, with offices in Greenwich and Darien, Connecticut. It diagnoses the cause of dry eye and treats it with in-office, drop-less therapies.

- Phone (both offices): (203) 202-0202
- Email: pro@drinnalazar.com
- Greenwich: 115 East Putnam Avenue, Greenwich, CT 06830. Mon, Wed–Fri 9–5; Tue 9–6; Sat by request; Sun closed.
- Darien: 36 Old Kings Highway South, Suite 110, Darien, CT 06820. Mon–Wed, Fri 9–5; Thu 9–6; Sat–Sun closed.
- Parent practice (eye exams, eyewear, myopia care): https://getproeyecare.com/

## Treatments
- [OptiLIGHT](https://dryeyecare.example.com/optilight): Intense pulsed light
- [OptiPLUS](https://dryeyecare.example.com/optiplus): Radiofrequency
- [TearCare](https://dryeyecare.example.com/tearcare): Targeted eyelid heat
- [Low-level light therapy](https://dryeyecare.example.com/low-level-light-therapy): Photobiomodulation
- [BlephEx](https://dryeyecare.example.com/blephex): Lid-margin exfoliation
- [ZEST](https://dryeyecare.example.com/zest): Eyelid cleansing
